## Uganda Christian University Library

### Uganda Christian University

* * *

Address: Bishop Tucker Road ; PO Box 4
Mukono,
Uganda

Phone: +256312350800

Connect to: Library Web Site❌   Online Catalog

Library details: Uganda Christian University Library is an Academic library.
This library is affiliated with Uganda Christian University (view map) . The collection of the library contains 140,000 volumes. The library serves a population of 7,500 FTE Enrollment.

Other Info: The University Library is housed in three centers, the Hamu Mukasa Library, Bishop Tucker Theology Library, an off Campus branch in the Capital city of Uganda; Kampala Campus library.
